samples.question: A dark reference line is drawn inside the grey box at the top of the image. Thin grey lines split the rest of the image into four sectors: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right. Every sector contains several small dark line fragments (the clutter). Exactly one sector contains a fragment that is an exact copy of the reference line; the fragments in the other three sectors are all differently shaped. Which sector contains the exact reference line? Answer with one sector name.
